meta.name: debug
meta.description: Debug container agent issues. Use when things aren't working, container fails, authentication problems, or to understand how the container system works. Covers logs, session DBs, mounts, and common issues.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 排查容器和 agent 运行问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常遇到容器或 agent 运行异常需要定位根因
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to diagnose container or agent runtime problems

howto.what: Claude 会排查容器代理故障:查看日志定位错误、查询会话数据库确认消息是否到达并产生回复、检查挂载与认证配置,并按常见问题给出修复方案(如停掉重复实例、重建容器镜像)。
howto.when: 当容器出问题(如启动失败、认证报错、消息无回复)或你想弄清容器系统如何运作时触发。

say.text: 容器没回消息,帮我查日志和会话数据库。
say.note: 会查会话记录,定位消息卡在哪一步。

say.text: 日志报 'No adapter for channel type',怎么办?
say.note: 会检查是否重复运行了服务实例,并停掉旧的。

say.text: 给我讲讲主机和容器之间是怎么传消息的。
say.note: 会以两个会话数据库为核心解释消息流。

howto.what_en: Claude can debug container agents by checking logs, querying session DBs to confirm message flow, inspecting mounts/auth, and walking through fixes for common issues.
howto.when_en: It applies when things aren't working, a container fails, authentication problems occur, or you want to understand how the container system works.

say_en.text: The container never replies. Check the logs and session DBs.
say_en.note: Checks inbound/outbound DBs to see where it stalled.

say_en.text: The log says 'No adapter for channel type'. What should I do?
say_en.note: Checks for duplicate instances and disables the stale one.

say_en.text: Explain how the host and container exchange messages.
say_en.note: Walks through the message flow using the two session DBs.
